summary: 22-year-old woman with a knee injury 200 feet below the summit of Longs Peak; visitors and park staff helped her to the Boulderfield, helicopter to Upper Beaver Meadows, then ground ambulance to Estes Park Medical Center (one of three NPS rescues that day)
notes: NPS morning report (reported 2010-08-18): Tuesday three-rescue day; notification via cell phone at 9 a.m.
